Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Lead de Analytics & AI para liderar tecnicamente um time multidisciplinar, atuando na construção de soluções baseadas em dados, machine learning e IA aplicada a problemas reais de negócio.

Essa posição é para quem combina excelência técnica, visão arquitetural e liderança, atuando próximo ao time, produto e negócio para tomar decisões técnicas, orientar o time e garantir entregas escaláveis e de qualidade.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Liderar tecnicamente o time, com protagonismo na definição de padrões de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e boas práticas
  • Apoiar o time na resolução de desafios técnicos, removendo impedimentos e orientando decisões
  • Atuar hands-on em demandas estratégicas ou de maior complexidade
  • Traduzir necessidades de produto e negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis, sustentáveis e alinhadas ao roadmap
  • Planejar e acompanhar entregas técnicas, participando de estimativas, prazos e priorização
  • Monitorar indicadores de engenharia e qualidade, mitigando riscos técnicos
  • Garantir práticas de qualidade, como code reviews, testes automatizados e documentação
  • Mentorar e desenvolver o time, com 1:1s, feedbacks e apoio à evolução profissional
  • Atuar como ponte entre tecnologia, produto e negócio, apoiando alinhamentos e decisões técnicas
  • Trabalhar em parceria com a área de arquitetura na construção de provas de conceito (PoCs) e na análise de viabilidade técnica de soluções.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência sólida em Ciência de Dados, Machine Learning e ML em produção (pipelines batch/streaming, deploy e monitoramento)
  • Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas de dados e ML, avaliando trade-offs
  • Conhecimento em engenharia de dados (modelagem OLTP/OLAP, Data Lakes, integrações e SQL)
  • Atuação fullstack, com backend em Python e integração com frontend em React e/ou Angular
  • Domínio de boas práticas de arquitetura de software e atuação como referência técnica do time
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de IA agêntica, agentes, MCPs e integração com plataformas de IA (ex.: AWS Bedrock).
  • Experiência com IA Generativa (RAG, embeddings, chains/agents)
  • Vivência com frameworks de agentes (ex.: LangChain, LangGraph ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em Data Mesh, governança de dados e sistemas de alta escala


LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto

▪️ Regime de contratação: CLT


BENEFÍCIOS

Remuneração Variável + Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

title: UX Designer Pleno
description:
Buscamos um(a) UX Designer Pleno com perfil criativo e experimental para atuar no design de experiências imersivas de nova geração, combinando mobile, XR, Voice AI e Generative AI em projetos inovadores.


O que esperamos de você:

• +3 anos de experiência como UX Designer, com pelo menos 2 anos em apps mobile, produtos inovadores ou projetos end-to-end

• Forte domínio de Figma (3+ anos), incluindo contato inicial com Figma Make

• Mentalidade criativa, curiosa e inovadora, com vontade de experimentar e aprender

• Portfólio com projetos usando Vibe Coding, Generative AI ou ferramentas experimentais

• Exposição inicial a XR/VR e interesse por experiências imersivas

• Interesse genuíno em design guiado por IA

• Inglês para atuação em ambiente internacional


O que você vai fazer:

• Projetar experiências XR e interativas de próxima geração

• Criar aplicações mobile XR intuitivas, fluidas e centradas no usuário

• Desenvolver experiências de Voice AI e Voice UI com foco humano

• Colaborar de perto com o time para transformar ideias criativas em soluções reais

• Criar conteúdos e vídeos gerados por IA para pitch decks e storytelling


Por que se juntar a nós:

• Atuar com tecnologias emergentes (XR, Voice AI, Generative AI)

• Trabalhar em um time moderno, criativo e colaborativo

• Ter espaço real para experimentação e inovação

• Crescimento em design imersivo e IA aplicada

title: Consultor financeiro
description:
Consultor Financeiro


Vitória, Espírito Santo, Brasil (Presencial)

Agro Não Para Brasil

Tipo de contratação: A combinar

Área: Comercial | Mercado Financeiro | Agronegócio




Sobre a empresa


A Agro Não Para Brasil é uma organização especializada na estruturação e captação de recursos financeiros para aquisição de propriedades rurais em todo o território nacional.


Atuamos conectando investidores e produtores a oportunidades estratégicas no agronegócio brasileiro, com foco em crescimento patrimonial, planejamento financeiro e expansão sustentável.


Com a expansão da operação no Espírito Santo, buscamos profissionais para integrar nossa equipe comercial em Vitória.




Responsabilidades


* Realizar prospecção ativa e qualificada de clientes potenciais;

* Conduzir reuniões comerciais consultivas;

* Apresentar soluções financeiras estruturadas para aquisição de propriedades rurais;

* Desenvolver relacionamento estratégico com investidores e produtores;

* Gerenciar pipeline comercial e acompanhar oportunidades até o fechamento;

* Contribuir diretamente para o crescimento da operação regional.




Requisitos


* Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;

* Perfil proativo e orientado a resultados;

* Organização e disciplina profissional;

* Comprometimento com metas;

* Interesse em atuar nos setores financeiro e do agronegócio.


Não exigimos experiência prévia. Valorizamos dedicação, postura profissional e ambição de crescimento.




Diferenciais


* Experiência nas áreas comercial, financeira ou agronegócio;

* Vivência com prospecção ativa e negociação;

* Perfil estratégico e analítico;

* Networking empresarial ou rural.




O que oferecemos


* Plano de desenvolvimento profissional;

* Remuneração compatível com o mercado (fixo + variável por desempenho);

* Ambiente orientado à performance;

* Oportunidade de crescimento interno;

* Participação em um projeto de impacto nacional no agronegócio.




Interessados podem se candidatar diretamente pela plataforma ou enviar currículo para avaliação.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Work Model :Remote

Location :Brazil/ Latam

  • Elixir OR Ruby + React, Typescript, NodeJS, etc - If candidates have either/or experience with just Elixir or just Ruby, please ensure they have front end AND back end experience.

What You Get To Do Every Day

- Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code that directly contributes to company-wide initiatives

- Develop using interesting technologies — Elixir, Ruby, React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

- Have significant input into technical decisions that will shape the future of our software systems

- Learn something new, whether it’s a new software design pattern or new initiative to push the company forward

- Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback to your peers

- Pair up with a team member to work together on features

- Deploy user-facing code to production


Skills/Experience

- 5+ years professional software development experience

- Fluency with either Elixir or Ruby

- Proficient with the latest versions of ECMAScript (JavaScript) as well as HTML and CSS

- Experience with React and common tools used in the wider React ecosystem, such as Node.js and npm

- Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools

- Familiarity with event-based architectures, database fundamentals, and GraphQL

- Enthusiasm for solving problems for our users with technology

- Curiosity about retail/e-commerce, the high-end consignment market, and/or how to create a sustainable, circular economy for luxury goods






Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


The Supply Chain Manager is responsible for managing end-to-end import operations, high-priority customer orders, and internal operational processes to ensure smooth, accurate, and reliable business performance. This role plays a critical part in maintaining customer satisfaction, financial accuracy, and operational efficiency, particularly within a food import and supply-chain environment. The Supply Chain Manager will also provide operational and administrative support to the CEO as required.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America. For Latin American candidates, kindly submit an English Version of your CV.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Manage end-to-end supply chain operations, including import coordination, supplier communication, freight forwarding, and customs documentation
  • Oversee high-priority customer orders to ensure on-time, in-full (OTIF) delivery and 100% customer satisfaction
  • Proactively identify and resolve operational issues, delays, and discrepancies before they impact customers or costs
  • Maintain accurate records in NetSuite for orders, inventory, shipments, and vendor bills
  • Track and reconcile import costs, freight charges, duties, and multi-currency transactions with high financial accuracy
  • Create, maintain, and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) within areas of responsibility
  • Build and maintain Excel-based trackers, reconciliations, and operational reports
  • Collaborate professionally with suppliers, freight partners, customers, and internal teams
  • Provide timely operational and administrative support to the CEO, including reporting, data analysis, and follow-ups on key action items


What We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • At least 2 years of experience managing import processes, ideally within the food industry
  • Proficiency in NetSuite or a similar ERP system
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (e.g., VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, formulas)
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace
  • Proficiency in NetSuite or a similar ERP system
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (e.g., VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, formulas)


Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary starting at USD 800 - 1,000 , with flexibility for higher compensation based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.

title: Ingeniero de soporte
description:
SaaS Support Engineer


Overview and Purpose


As a SaaS Support Engineer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of Markmonitor Group’s growing number of cloud-based services but with specific emphasis on our Microsoft suite of SaaS services. Your focus will be on providing exceptional technical support to end-users, managing SaaS platforms, and managing/enhancing security controls within the scope of the company's ISMS.



SaaS Support

· Manage and administer Markmonitor Group’s SaaS applications with emphasis on our Microsoft 365 and Azure Active Directory implementation and user base.

· Ensure that Microsoft 365 product knowledge is shared with team members on a regular basis and that collectively we build our team knowledge of the 365 ecosystem.

· Stay informed of and promote through prototyping/POCs, new products and features to help with business workflow efficiency, compliance and with opportunities to reduce cost.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to collect requirements, design, configure, deploy and manage SaaS applications.

· Administer and maintain SaaS platforms, ensuring optimal performance and availability.

· Monitor service health, troubleshoot incidents, and escalate complex issues as needed.


Technical Support

· Provide first line IT technical support to company staff through in person and remote means keeping staff Informed of progress.

· Troubleshoot and resolve user issues related to software functionality, access, and performance.

· Ensure monitoring, prioritizing and triaging of support tickets and promptly establish resolution ownership. Wherever possible owning and resolving tickets within the 1st line team or escalating them where necessary to the appropriate 2nd line support team.

· Working closely with all technology functional teams to onboard systems knowledge and skills needed to resolve more tickets at the front line.

· Purchasing, configuring and managing the company's Windows and Apple based PCs, laptops and printers/peripherals and ensuring the asset register Is maintained.

· Administering the company's VOIP telephone system (BT Cloud).


InfoSec Support

· Implement security best practices across company SaaS services and ensure Inventory of SaaS services Is maintained.

· Working with the IT Operations team to maintain the company's Microsoft Secure Score at 70%+ through effective monitoring and use of adopted security applications and services which Include

o Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

o Microsoft InTune

· Further improve Security Posture through controlled and tested implementation of Secure Score recommendations as they relate to Identity management, data, devices and app management.

· Ensuring full compliance with Markmonitor Group’s ISMS (certified to ISO27701) in general and specifically as It relates to IT technical support services.

· Collaborate with Markmonitor Group’s SOC In the analysis and resolution of security related incidents. These will largely be tracked In our SIEM platform, Microsoft Sentinel.



Other relevant support Activities

· Provide support to the marketing department with respect to the ongoing maintenance of company (wordpress) websites.

· Provide the IT Operations team with project office support to help the team's engineers focus on delivery rather than management.

· Keep the management updated with regular progress/Issues/risks for both project specific or BAU conducted by the technical support team.



Qualifications and Skills

· 2 Years + experience in a relevant role.

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field however work experience Is more Important.

· Demonstrable use of administering the Microsoft 365 suite of services used by the company (see skills matrix)

· Proportional understanding of cybersecurity principles and best practices, including threat detection, incident response, and compliance. Is not expected to be an authority but can demonstrate good industry and technology awareness. Proactively contributing to ongoing improvement in the company’s security posture.

· Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

· Excellent communication and customer service skills.

· You should demonstrate appropriate skills and knowledge in the use of the following technologies and frameworks.

title: Analista de Suporte AMS
description:
Já pensou em fazer parte de uma empresa Great Place to Work com a melhor solução para comércio exterior do mercado? Confira agora as responsabilidades e os requisitos para a vaga.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Atender e apoiar clientes na utilização do sistema, garantindo uma experiência eficiente e clara;
  • Realizar gestão de chamados, assegurando priorização adequada e cumprimento de SLAs.
  • Investigar e solucionar dúvidas, erros e problemas relacionados ao uso do sistema;
  • Participar de reuniões e acompanhamentos periódicos com clientes;
  • Colaborar com outras áreas internas (desenvolvimento, QA, produto) para garantir a resolução eficiente dos chamados;
  • Documentar atendimentos e contribuir com a melhoria dos processos de suporte;
  • Executar testes de validação e regressão em novas versões do sistema;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e reportá-las de forma estruturada;
  • Abrir e acompanhar backlogs e bugs junto às áreas responsáveis.
  • Realizar configurações de rotinas e parametrizações do sistema conforme necessidade do cliente.
  • Ajustar relatórios e auxiliar usuários na correta utilização das funcionalidades.



REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Ensino superior (concluído ou em andamento) ou técnico nas áreas de, Comércio Exterior, Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento ao cliente, especialmente em ambiente técnico ou corporativo;
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade analítica e habilidade para lidar com problemas de forma estruturada;



DESEJÁVEL

  • Experiência prévia com suporte a software ou suporte AMS;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de despacho aduaneiro, incluindo rotinas de importação e exportação;
  • Conhecimentos em MySQL ou SQL Server para consultas e análises básicas;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de Comércio Exterior ou ERPs será um diferencial.




Acreditamos em construir juntos , com respeito, inovação, bem-estar e, acima de tudo, cuidado mútuo .

title: Content Writer (German) - 60025
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Content Writer to create and refine content used in workflows, training data, and scenario-based evaluations for large language models (LLMs). You will help build realistic content samples, review AI-generated outputs, and ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create and edit content across formats such as articles, guides, workflows, and scenarios.
  • Recreate real-world content workflows for AI evaluation.
  • Review AI outputs for quality, accuracy, and adherence to guidelines.
  • Collaborate with product and AI teams to align content with operational needs.


Required Qualifications:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory (English and German) : Ability to read and write in English and Portuguese with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • 2+ years experience as a Content Writer, Copywriter, or Technical Writer.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify content gaps or inconsistencies.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Familiarity with documentation or workflow tools (e.g., Confluence, Notion, Zendesk, Jira).
  • Experience creating datasets for LLMs (prompt writing, SFT, RLHF, eval benchmarks, red teaming, QA).
  • Familiarity with structured formats and tools: JSON (reading/writing, basic structure), Google Colab / Jupyter notebooks, Spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets), Slack.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : at least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 1 month (can extend).
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (4 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Evaluation Process :

  • Applicants must complete a business writing assessment (English) followed by a language proficiency assessment (German).
  • Shortlisted candidates will be reviewed by our team internally and shortlisted candidates will be reached out for onboarding.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals , and earn money from your network.

title: Full Stack Engineer PHP/Javascript
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer


Role Type: Full-Time Regular Employment

Setup: Fully Remote

Duration: Open-ended, Long term

Hours: 40 hours per week

Schedule: US Eastern Time (EST)

Rate: USD 3,500-4,000 per month


Position Overview:


The Senior Full Stack Engineer will play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining our client’s core business applications. We are looking for a true systems analyst who thrives on solving complex business challenges and translating them into robust, scalable, and high-performing technical solutions. This individual must be highly comfortable working with pure code without relying on frameworks , especially in areas where the company prefers clean, raw implementations. The ideal candidate should have strong foundational skills in vanilla JavaScript , pure PHP , and writing code from scratch without the support of abstractions or libraries.


You will work across both the front-end and back-end of modern web applications using PHP, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL, and React , collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver efficient and maintainable systems. Strong English communication skills are essential for interacting with internal stakeholders, product owners, and developers across global teams.


What You Will Do:


The individual in this position will be expected, on a regular basis, to:

  • Design, develop, and maintain back-end functionality for enterprise-level business applications using PHP in pure form , avoiding unnecessary frameworks when required.
  • Build and enhance interactive, responsive front-end interfaces using vanilla JavaScript , along with React when applicable.
  • Develop and optimize databases using MySQL and PostgreSQL , including schema design, complex queries, indexing, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
  • Write clean, well-structured, and well-tested code without depending heavily on frameworks, ensuring clarity and maintainability.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications for speed, scalability, and long-term stability.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to decisions involving raw code structure, system design, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to ensure the product is performant, reliable, and aligned with business goals.
  • Stay updated with evolving best practices in no-framework development , JavaScript, PHP, SQL, and full stack engineering.
  • Mentor and guide junior developers, especially in understanding code fundamentals and building solutions without relying on frameworks.
  • Prepare and maintain clear and detailed technical documentation.


What You Will Bring:


  • Proven ability to write clean, well-documented, and well-tested pure code in both PHP and JavaScript (examples may be requested).
  • Strong knowledge of vanilla JavaScript , DOM manipulation, event handling, and building functionality without libraries.
  • Expertise in MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL , with hands-on experience designing and maintaining relational databases.
  • Proficiency with React or modern front-end frameworks, while still having the ability to work without them when needed.
  • Experience with object-oriented programming (OOP) and design patterns.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working in agile, team-based environments.
  • Knowledge of the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry is a plus.
  • A strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and a passion for writing beautiful code.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced, globally distributed environment.


Minimum Qualifications:


  • 10+ years of experience in full stack development.
  • Hands-on experience with pure PHP , vanilla JavaScript , MySQL , PostgreSQL , SQL , and React in production environments.

title: Analista Programador Dynamics Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Analista Programador Dynamics Sênior para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, inovador e orientado a resultados. Este profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas técnicas de alta complexidade dentro do ecossistema do Dynamics 365 , garantindo integrações robustas, automações inteligentes e soluções escaláveis. Além do domínio técnico, buscamos alguém com forte postura de liderança, habilidade em mentoria e visão estratégica para contribuir no desenvolvimento de equipes e na evolução contínua dos produtos.


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolvimento de plugins em C# para Microsoft Dynamics;
  • Criação e manutenção de Azure Functions para integração com OData do Dynamics;
  • Integração com Kafka e Azure Service Bus;
  • Monitoramento, análise e operação de logs via Application Insights;
  • Execução de troubleshooting e resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Criação, otimização e automação de fluxos no Power Automate;
  • Liderança técnica e mentoria de desenvolvedores;
  • Implementação, facilitação e gestão de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban etc.);
  • Gestão de pessoas, desenvolvimento de talentos e acompanhamento de performance;
  • Planejamento, definição e gerenciamento de roadmaps de produtos .


Requisitos:


  • Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento em C#;
  • Profundo conhecimento em Dynamics 365;
  • Experiência com Azure Functions e integrações via OData;
  • Familiaridade com Kafka e Azure Service Bus;
  • Experiência com monitoramento em Application Insights;
  • Forte capacidade de troubleshooting e resolução de incidentes;
  • Experiência com Power Automate;
  • Vivência em liderança de times de tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento e prática em metodologias ágeis;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e gestão de pessoas;
  • Capacidade de planejamento e gestão de roadmap;
  • Conhecimento em JavaScript com SDK do Dynamics .


Diferenciais:


  • Certificações em Dynamics 365 e Microsoft Azure;
  • Experiência em projetos de integração complexa;
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação, colaboração e trabalho em equipe.

title: Suporte Técnico de Inversor Fotovoltaico
description:
Descrição de Cargo:


Atendimento Técnico


1. Conhecimento dos inversores: É importante ter experiência com inversor, incluindo o entendimento de seus recursos, configurações, parâmetros e modos de operação.


2. Diagnóstico e solução de problemas: Ter habilidades em diagnóstico de falhas e solução de problemas é fundamental para o suporte técnico de inversores. Isso envolve a capacidade de identificar e solucionar problemas comuns, como falhas de comunicação, erros de configuração, sobrecargas, curtos-circuitos, entre outros.


3. Configuração: Em muitos casos, os inversores possuem interfaces de configuração, onde é necessário alterar parâmetros e ajustar as configurações de acordo com as necessidades dos clientes. Ter habilidades em configuração de inversores é valioso nesse contexto.


4. Habilidades de comunicação: Além do conhecimento técnico, é importante ter boas habilidades de comunicação para interagir com os clientes, entender suas necessidades, explicar soluções de problemas e fornecer suporte adequado. Isso inclui a capacidade de se comunicar claramente, ouvir atentamente e ser paciente.


Responsabilidades:


● Dar suporte técnico aos clientes à distância e de forma presencial (se necessário);

● Registrar os atendimentos diariamente;

● Preparar e aplicar treinamento;

● Participar de eventos e feiras do setor de energia atendendo ao público;


Requisitos:


● Formação: Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica

● Domínio no Pacote Office, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook;

● Disponibilidade para Viajar pelo Brasil;


Modalidade de trabalho:


● Home Office, de Segunda a Sexta-Feira das 09:00 ás 18:00h

4. Habilidades de comunicação: Além do conhecimento técnico, é importante ter boas habilidades de comunicação para interagir com os clientes, entender suas necessidades, explicar soluções de problemas e fornecer suporte adequado. title: Senior Software Engineer – Platform
description:
Role: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Reliability Operations

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Type: Contract


Responsibilities:

  • Analyze and improve system design to reduce failure modes and promote self-healing systems
  • Establish and maintain robust systems that facilitate observability, encompassing logging, monitoring, distributed tracing, alerting, and offline test tools.
  • Work with development partners to shape the architecture, design, and implementations of new and existing systems to enhance their reliability, performance, efficiency, and scalability
  • Ability to work both independently as well as part of a geographically dispersed yet integrated team.
  • Collaborate with service engineers to establish Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for backend services.
  • Being able to identify the indications or cues that demonstrate the effectiveness of an application and having the knowledge to improve or repair its performance
  • Ability to assess options and suggest solutions when there is limited or unclear information. This position requires a level of comfort and assurance in dealing with uncertain situations.
  • Ability to work seamlessly within a team as well as manage individual tasks
  • Respond to emerging incidents, solve critical issues, and follow through with a plan for resolution or future mitigation
  • Act as an SME on the Engineering Operations team, partnering with backend services teams and application teams to overcome challenges across all the platforms where we stream our service

Required Skills:

  • 5+ years’ experience in software development
  • Degree in Computer Science or related or equivalent work experience
  • You have solid engineering and coding skills, data structure knowledge, and the ability to write high-performance production-quality code.
  • Experience building service-oriented APIs and cloud services
  • Experience designing, implementing, and deploying microservices
  • Extremely technical hands-on server software experience
  • Proficient in Golang, and JavaScript, and quick to learn new languages.
  • Experience in the Linux environment and a good understanding of its fundamentals and internals: filesystems and modern memory management, threads, and processes, the user/kernel-space divide, etc.
  • A good understanding of large-scale distributed systems in practice, including multi-tier architectures, application security, monitoring, and storage systems.
  • Working knowledge of the TCP/IP stack, internet routing, and load balancing.
  • Grit, drive, and a deep feeling of ownership.

Bonus Points for Experience with the following:

  • Golang
  • Typescript
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform
  • Open telemetry
  • eBPF
  • Datadog
  • Helm Charts
  • HLS video transcoding, distribution & playback
  • Experience designing, implementing, and running services in high demand high-traffic environments
  • Experience with high-availability services

title: Hiring Spanish Language Translators and Linguist for LLM Annotation Work
description:
Company Description

DeepLLMData specializes in providing high-quality annotated data for advanced machine learning models. Our expertise includes supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and domain-specific data services for STEM fields, PhDs, mathematics, as well as image and video annotation. We support frontier technologies with expert human data, empowering state-of-the-art AI development. Through our skilled workforce, we partner with clients to deliver precise and impactful data solutions.


Role Description

This is a remote, contract-based position for skilled Spanish Translators and Linguists for large language model (LLM) annotation work. This role is task based and on contract basis. Responsibilities include translating Audio and annotating Spanish text, ensuring linguistic accuracy, performing language analysis, and supporting culturally appropriate output for AI models. The role may also involve developing linguistic guidelines and maintaining data quality throughout the annotation process or working on Text to Speech as well.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Spanish and English, including advanced linguistic and cultural knowledge
  • Experience in translation and annotation
  • Strong attention to detail, language accuracy, and quality control
  • Previous work with AI/data annotation tools is advantageous
  • Effective communication skills and ability to meet deadlines
  • Bachelor's degree in Linguistics, Translation Studies, Computational Linguistics, or a related field preferred

title: Senior AI/ML Developer
description:
About The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Developer to lead the technical development of an Industrial RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solution for a major US-based client. The project addresses a critical challenge: transitioning 25 years of historical lab reports from SharePoint into an intelligent, GenAI-powered knowledge retrieval system.

You will be responsible for building a two-phase solution, starting with a Proof of Concept (POC) for a Pricing Analyst Agent and evolving into a Production-Ready Conversational AI Agent. This role focuses on automating knowledge retrieval, preserving institutional expertise, and enhancing the accuracy of fluid design processes through scalable AWS architectures.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and validate robust AI architectures leveraging AWS Infrastructure, specifically Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker.
  • Create GenAI pipelines and multi-agent workflows using AWS Step Functions, Lambda, and EventBridge.
  • Design platforms for processing massive volumes of unstructured data (text, image, audio, and video) integrated with RAG patterns.
  • Build interactive front-ends and AI dashboards using Streamlit for demos and operational workflows.
  • Implement best practices for AI governance, security, and observability using AWS IAM and CloudWatch.
  • Fine-tune pricing normalization and data retrieval to reduce bid risk and improve decision accuracy.


Required Qualifications

  • Good English communication skills (mandatory for direct collaboration with US stakeholders).
  • Proven hands-on experience building real-world GenAI applications using commercial LLMs.
  • Deep technical knowledge of the AWS ecosystem, including Serverless architectures and AI-specific services.
  • Strong experience building intelligent pipelines and event-oriented architectures.
  • Ability to design, test, and evaluate prompt engineering strategies and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience handling complex, unstructured data sources at scale.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with industrial-scale data migrations (SharePoint to Cloud).
  • Background in data science, specifically related to pricing normalization or cost baselines.
  • AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty or AWS Certified AI Practitioner certifications.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals , and earn money from your network.

The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals , and earn money from your network.

title: Tech Lead Hands-on (Microsoft Stack)
description:
Tech Lead Hands-on (Microsoft Stack)


Sobre a vaga:


Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead Hands-on com sólida bagagem técnica e experiência no ecossistema Microsoft, para liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções de IA, automação e produtividade em um ambiente colaborativo e inovador.


Essa posição combina liderança técnica e atuação prática em código , com foco em prototipar MVPs , garantir boas práticas de engenharia e impulsionar o uso de tecnologias Microsoft como Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, SharePoint e Databricks .


A atuação é 100% remota , mas seria um diferencial profissionais com disponibilidade para encontros presenciais em Guarulhos – SP, uma vez por semana .

Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente times multidisciplinares no desenho e execução de soluções em nuvem e IA.
  • Atuar de forma hands-on , participando ativamente de análises, codificação e revisão de código.
  • Prototipar e desenvolver MVPs (Minimum Viable Products) para validação e aceleração de entregas.
  • Utilizar a Microsoft Suite completa (Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint) na criação de soluções integradas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de dados e negócio para identificar oportunidades de automação e eficiência.
  • Garantir qualidade técnica, segurança, performance e escalabilidade das soluções construídas.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada como Tech Lead , Engenheiro(a) de Software ou Arquiteto(a) de Soluções , com atuação prática em desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Azure Cloud (preferencialmente AI e Data Services).
  • Experiência com Azure AI Foundry e Copilot Studio .
  • Domínio em Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint).
  • Vivência com Databricks e integração de dados e APIs.
  • Capacidade de construir e evoluir provas de conceito e MVPs funcionais .
  • Forte base em engenharia de software (versionamento, testes, pipelines de CI/CD, boas práticas).

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com IA generativa e copilots personalizados .
  • Vivência com MLOps , DataOps ou automação inteligente.
  • Experiência em Projetos corporativos de transformação digital .
  • Inglês técnico para leitura, documentação e acompanhamento de roadmaps de produto.
  • Disponibilidade para presença semanal em Guarulhos – SP .

Perfil esperado:

  • Profissional com visão sistêmica e perfil de liderança técnica , capaz de unir estratégia e execução.
  • Autonomia e proatividade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e em evolução constante.
  • Paixão por tecnologia Microsoft e inovação com IA.
  • Boa comunicação, colaboração e clareza ao traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Nós somos a Bring IT!


Somos uma empresa de serviços profissionais em rápido crescimento e altamente dinâmica, levando transformação digital a clientes em todo o mundo. Desde o lançamento de produtos no mercado até o aumento da produtividade com a tecnologia e os processos certos, o trabalho que realizamos está transformando a maneira como as pessoas trabalham.

Para chegar lá, estamos construindo uma equipe global e diversa, capaz de enfrentar alguns dos desafios mais complexos do nosso tempo. Chamamos essa abordagem única de “360 Success”.


Somos reconhecidos como uma das empresas que mais crescem e têm mais sucesso no ranking Inc. 5000 dos Estados Unidos, e estamos abrindo novos escritórios pelo mundo para continuar crescendo, explorando e diversificando. Com mais de 10 reconhecimentos de parceiros, seguimos expandindo nossa presença nos mercados digitais.

Junte-se ao nosso Dream Team


A equipe Bring IT conta com mais de 300 profissionais espalhados por diversos países. Entendemos que grandes tecnologias começam com grandes talentos e com a diversidade de pensamento.

Nosso negócio é construído sobre conexão, trabalho em equipe e paixão pelo que fazemos. Esses valores moldam nossa cultura todos os dias — e estamos em busca de talentos que queiram gerar impacto no mundo.

Na Bring IT, você pode construir uma carreira gratificante, pois estamos comprometidos em apoiar seu crescimento profissional e pessoal.


Como Engenheiro(a) De Software Sênior, Você Irá

  • Orientar e dar suporte técnico a outros Engenheiros de Software.
  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento nas atividades do dia a dia.
  • Colaborar diretamente com clientes ou com suas equipes de desenvolvimento, oferecendo orientação e treinamento.
  • Conduzir análise, design, codificação, avaliação, modificação, testes e implementação de scripts e novas funcionalidades no NetSuite ERP.
  • Desenvolver customizações dentro do NetSuite para dar suporte a processos de negócios críticos.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Gerar documentação detalhada de processos, incluindo testes de produto, dados, fluxogramas, diagramas, layouts, comentários de código e outros materiais técnicos.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento NetSuite (scripts, workflows, relatórios).
  • Domínio em JavaScript.
  • Compreensão de arquitetura de sistemas, design orientado a objetos, frameworks web e padrões de desenvolvimento.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias SDLC (Software Development Lifecycle).
  • Proficiência em resolução e tratamento de erros e debugging.
  • Experiência com ambientes de desenvolvimento integrados (IDEs), sistemas de controle de versão, ferramentas de testes unitários e gestão de defeitos.
  • Experiência com Webservices (SOAP e REST).
  • Conhecimento em GIT.


Habilidades e Qualificações Desejadas

  • Experiência com NetSuite.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação.
  • Graduação em Contabilidade (CPA) é um diferencial.
  • Experiência em consultoria de TI ou de negócios.
  • Proficiência em inglês.
  • Certificações NetSuite.
  • Habilidades funcionais, de implementação e liderança serão consideradas um diferencial.

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
bout Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals , and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Hello from RE Partners!


Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”


This role exists to drive value for our customers and business functions through effective data engineering, modelling, and data transformations by leading the delivery of strategic data solutions whilst setting up resilient data architecture and engineering foundations and supporting junior members of the data engineering team.


Responsible for:

  • Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.
  • Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.
  • Implementing modern code development and data engineering orchestration strategies to target and streamline our data engineering processes.
  • Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.
  • Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and/or implement new data solutions and processes.
  • Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied/maintained.


Accountable for:

  • Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of DevOps and modern code development practices across the Data function.
  • Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.
  • Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.
  • Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.
  • Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.


Essential skills and experience:

  • Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.
  • GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow
  • Hands on Java experience
  • Hands on experience in modern code development practices (Infrastructure-as-Code) and data engineering in the Google Cloud
  • Experience of ETL/ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.
  • Proven experience of data warehousing, data wrangling and data modelling approaches.
  • Proven experience coaching junior members of data engineering teams and supporting their skills development.
  • Proven experience working collaboratively with System, Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
  • Demonstrable experience of critical thinking, communication and problem-solving ability and stakeholder management
  • Demonstrate delivery under pressure and to deadline.
  • Experience working in an e-commerce/retail market would be beneficial.


Preferred skills and experience:

  • Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.
  • Able to establish what does/doesn’t align to business/functional strategies/priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.
  • Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
  • Embrace change with a positive outlook.
  • Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.



Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus


Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”


This role exists to drive value for our customers and business functions through effective data engineering, modelling, and data transformations by leading the delivery of strategic data solutions whilst setting up resilient data architecture and engineering foundations and supporting junior members of the data engineering team.


Responsible for:

  • Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.
  • Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.
  • Implementing modern code development and data engineering orchestration strategies to target and streamline our data engineering processes.
  • Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.
  • Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and/or implement new data solutions and processes.
  • Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied/maintained.


Accountable for:

  • Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of DevOps and modern code development practices across the Data function.
  • Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.
  • Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.
  • Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.
  • Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.


Essential skills and experience:

  • Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.
  • GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow
  • Hands on Java experience
  • Hands on experience in modern code development practices (Infrastructure-as-Code) and data engineering in the Google Cloud
  • Experience of ETL/ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.
  • Proven experience of data warehousing, data wrangling and data modelling approaches.
  • Proven experience coaching junior members of data engineering teams and supporting their skills development.
  • Proven experience working collaboratively with System, Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
  • Demonstrable experience of critical thinking, communication and problem-solving ability and stakeholder management
  • Demonstrate delivery under pressure and to deadline.
  • Experience working in an e-commerce/retail market would be beneficial.


Preferred skills and experience:

  • Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.
  • Able to establish what does/doesn’t align to business/functional strategies/priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.
  • Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
  • Embrace change with a positive outlook.
  • Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.



Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus


Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Electrical BIM Speiclaist
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.

We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:

Eracore is growing in Brazil , and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U.S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.


Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Eracore

• Competitive hourly pay

• Fully remote work

• Learning platforms for professional growth

• Supportive leadership and mentorship


Your Role

  • Perform VDC production work including electrical BIM modeling, coordination support, shop drawings, and spool/prefabrication drawings based on project requirements.
  • Do assigned tasks and deliverables on time and accurately.
  • Ensure meeting design requirements, NEC code compliance expectations, Eracore quality standards, client requirements, and project specifications.
  • Support coordination by identifying clashes, assisting in resolving coordination conflicts, and implementing required updates within the model and drawings.
  • Follow Eracore modeling standards, drawing standards, and project.
  • Provide regular updates on progress, raise questions when scope or design intent is unclear, communicate issues that may impact schedule or quality.
  • Identify missing information or unclear details and communicate clarification needs to senior staff.
  • Actively participate in training and apply feedback from reviews to improve technical performance overall deliverable quality.
  • Work collaboratively with team members to meet project deadlines, support coordination needs.


What We’re Looking For

•2+ years of experience in Electrical BIM

• Experience in modeling of electrical systems

• Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus

• Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection

• Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam

• Team-oriented mindset

• Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused

• Spoken and technical written Intermediate English

title: Omnistudio Developer
description:
Salesforce Developer – OmniStudio & Communications Cloud


The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering scalable and high‑quality Salesforce solutions within a digital transformation project in the telecommunications industry. You will work with OmniStudio, Salesforce Communications Cloud, and core Salesforce technologies to build optimized business processes. You will test your code, ensure quality through best practices, and collaborate in Agile environments.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement scalable solutions using OmniStudio (OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures).
  • Build and configure applications within Salesforce Communications Cloud (formerly Vlocity CPQ/EPC).
  • Participate in the development of telecom business processes such as quote‑to‑order , customer onboarding , and service provisioning .
  • Write clear, maintainable, and high‑quality code using Apex , LWC , and Salesforce configuration tools.
  • Support integration development using REST, SOAP, JSON, XML .
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, estimation, and reviews.
  • Perform unit testing and provide support throughout SIT and UAT cycles.
  • Document technical specifications, solution designs, and deployment guidelines.
  • Contribute to CI/CD workflows using tools such as Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant .


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience with Salesforce development .
  • 2+ years of experience with OmniStudio development.
  • Strong experience with:
  • OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures
  • Salesforce configuration, Apex , and LWC
  • Salesforce Communications Cloud (Vlocity CPQ & EPC)
  • Experience integrating systems using REST/SOAP APIs and working with JSON/XML formats.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant).
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments (SAFe Agile preferred).
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.


Preferred Certifications

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I
  • OmniStudio Developer Certification
  • Salesforce Industries CPQ Developer (nice to have)

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.


Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.


Como é o ambiente de trabalho?


Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

title: SAP Cloud Architect - SAP Basis
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Are you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.


About the Role


As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.


Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required.


What You’ll Gain


Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.

Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.

Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.

A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

title: Thumbnail Designer (Art Director)  - Crypto Media
description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top YouTube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto .Today, with 80+ team members and over 10M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!


Role Overview

Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.


What you’ll do

  • Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain \"Brilliance or Nothing\" standards.
  • Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and \"breaking\" narratives into punchy, high-CTR YouTube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
  • Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.
  • Optimise for Performance & CTR: Apply a deep understanding of YouTube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the \"click\" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant.
  • Operationalise Design Workflows: Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the \"Stream Team\" before go-live.
  • Cross-Functional Creative Direction: Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and \"elite\" visual identity across all platforms.



Your skills and experience

  • Visual Storytelling and Execution: Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and \"breaking\" market news into high-impact YouTube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click.
  • Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy: A deep-rooted \"fellow degen\" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves.
  • Creative Leadership and Briefing: Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution.
  • YouTube Psychology and Backend Mastery: A strong understanding of YouTube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels.
  • High-Velocity Performance: Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis.
  • Strategic Communication and Copywriting: Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity

title: Salesforce QA Manual
description:
QA Manual Tester – Salesforce

The ideal candidate will be responsible for validating the quality, functionality, and user experience of Salesforce-based applications. You will design and execute manual test cases, analyze requirements, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure high‑quality product delivery. You will identify defects, support regression cycles, and participate actively in Agile ceremonies.


Responsibilities

  • Analyze business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to ensure full test coverage.
  • Design, execute, and document manual functional test cases.
  • Validate application behavior across various environments (Dev, QA, UAT ).
  • Perform cross‑browser testing and verify UI alignment with design and UX specifications.
  • Log defects with clear reproduction steps and work closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.
  • Maintain and update regression test suites to support continuous delivery.
  • Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies (daily standups, sprint reviews, retrospectives).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute to continuous process improvement.


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience working with Salesforce in a QA or functional testing role.
  • Strong understanding of CRM concepts beyond end-user functionality.
  • Semi‑Senior to Senior experience in manual software testing .
  • Knowledge and hands-on experience with Agile Scrum methodology .
  • Experience working with Jira and Azure DevOps for test management and defect tracking.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in collaborative environments.
  • Proactive mindset, ownership, and strong attention to detail.


Preferred Certifications (Not mandatory)

  • Salesforce Administrator
  • Salesforce App Builder
  • Salesforce Associate
