title: LATAM Laywer
description:
Eudia is revolutionising legal work through AI-powered Augmented Intelligence, empowering Fortune 500 legal teams to accelerate decision-making, mitigate risk, and drive strategic growth. With $105M in Series A funding led by General Catalyst, we’re crafting a category-defining platform that fuses AI-driven automation with human expertise, transforming legal departments into engines of innovation.


At Eudia, we move fast. Unlike traditional enterprise software, our teams ship solutions in days, not months—delivering real impact for some of the world’s largest companies. We’re solving one of the most complex, unsolved challenges in AI: bringing trust, accuracy, and security to legal automation. We’re passionate about reshaping the legal industry. If you’re looking for a place where you’ll be challenged, take ownership from day one, and work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI and legal —we’d love to tell you more.


Contract Attorney – LATAM Procurement (Portuguese & English Speaking)

Remote | LATAM | Full-time | 12-Month Contract


Eudia is partnering with a global, market-leading organization in the agribusiness and commodities sector to support its LATAM legal operations. We are seeking a mid-level Contract Attorney with strong procurement experience to join a high-volume, fast-paced contracts team on a 12-month fixed-term contract .


This role focuses on procurement and transportation-related agreements , supporting business stakeholders across LATAM. The successful candidate will work primarily in Portuguese, with the ability to communicate confidently in English in a regional and global environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Contract triage and intake
  • Review, redline, and negotiate procurement contracts (standard templates and third-party paper)
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external counterparties
  • Prepare clear summary comments on negotiated terms
  • Populate and maintain contract templates
  • Manage contract intake and workflows using Onit or similar contract management systems


Scope of Work

  • ~58% Procurement Contract Templates (CPT – no master agreement)
  • ~16% CPT Master Agreements
  • ~26% General Procurement Agreements
  • (All agreements fall within procurement, including transportation-related contracts.)


Requirements

  • Qualified lawyer in Brazil , with a Brazilian law license and legal training completed in Brazil
  • Mid-level legal experience in procurement, commercial, or contracts-focused roles
  • Fluency in Portuguese (written and spoken); all contracts and negotiations are conducted in Portuguese
  • Professional working proficiency in English
  • Strong knowledge of local procurement workflows in Brazil/LATAM
  • Experience reviewing and negotiating procurement or commercial agreements
  • Familiarity with contract lifecycle management tools (Onit experience preferred)


Additional Information

  • 12-month contract
  • Full-time position
  • LATAM-focused role aligned to Brazil time zone
  • Detailed workflows and processes will be provided during onboarding


If you’re a mid-level procurement-focused contract attorney looking to work with a globally recognized business through Eudia, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Software Engineer Pleno Mobile
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit

  • Experience with SAP Finance (preferably S4 HANA Finance or S4 HANA Cloud)

  • Strong SAP configuration knowledge and testing for core FICO areas: GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, CCA, CO-PA, Banking and Interface

  • Experience in SNOW, CHARM, HP ALM.

  • Research and document current business processes and provide process improvement recommendations to the business

Advanced English and Spanish

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados com foco em Inteligência Artificial
description:
Sobre a vaga:


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados com foco em Inteligência Artificial , para atuar em um projeto estratégico, com forte uso de Azure AI Foundry / Copilot Studio , apoiando a construção, evolução e sustentação de soluções de IA.


Essa posição exige um perfil mais técnico , com boa base em engenharia de dados e integração com soluções de IA.


A atuação é 100% remota , mas seria um diferencial profissionais com disponibilidade para encontros presenciais em Guarulhos – SP, uma vez por semana .

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e sustentar pipelines de dados para soluções de IA
  • Atuar na engenharia de soluções de IA , do desenho à implementação em produção
  • Trabalhar com Azure AI Foundry / Copilot Studio no desenvolvimento de agentes e aplicações inteligentes
  • Integrar dados, modelos e serviços de IA aos sistemas corporativos
  • Apoiar melhorias técnicas, performance, governança e segurança das soluções
  • Atuar em parceria com times de negócio e tecnologia

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados
  • Conhecimento prático em Azure (Data Services e/ou AI Services)
  • Experiência com Azure AI Foundry / Copilot Studio
  • Conhecimento em:
  • Python
  • SQL
  • Integração de APIs
  • Pipelines de dados
  • Vivência com soluções de IA em ambiente corporativo

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com modelos de IA generativa
  • Conhecimento em MLOps
  • Experiência com Databricks
  • Vivência em projetos de automação inteligente ou chatbots corporativos
  • Inglês técnico para leitura e documentação
  • Disponibilidade para presença semanal em Guarulhos – SP .

Perfil esperado:

  • Forte perfil técnico e analítico
  • Autonomia para atuar em ambientes em evolução
  • Boa comunicação com áreas técnicas e de negócio
  • Interesse genuíno por IA aplicada a problemas reais

title: Product Owner SR
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Product Owners experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.


O Product Owner trabalhará com equipes de ágeis para evolução da maturidade de produto e maximização da entrega de valor em ambiente Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


Duties and Responsibilities:


  • Garantir a elaboração, refinamento e priorização continua o Backlog da equipe ágil de acordo com DoR estabelecido;
  • Entender, contribuir e influenciar os aspectos de negócios que compõem o Backlog do produto;
  • Interagir com Product Manager, Business Owners, SMEs e outros Product Owners para elaboração de Features e User Stories;
  • Colaborar na elaboração das Features e elaborar User Stories incluindo critérios de aceitação e rastreabilidade de requisitos;
  • Analisar Features e User Stories com Product Manager e outras partes interessadas para garantir que atendam às necessidades do cliente;
  • Participar continuamente das rotinas e cerimônias do time ágil; facilitar as discussões, fornecer esclarecimento, refinar user stories e critérios de aceitação, validar e aceitar entregas de produto;
  • Contribuir para atividades de design de soluções e decisões de produto;
  • Compreender os requisitos de segurança e compliance; estabelecer integração perfeita com as equipes de segurança cibernética e conformidade;
  • Utilizar ferramentas para planejar e rastrear User Stories, critérios de aceitação e rastreabilidade de requisitos de produto;
  • Fornecer status sobre o progresso dos objetivos de negócios sob responsabilidade da equipe ágil;
  • Liderar esforços para identificação e resolução definitiva de problemas de produção;
  • Participar de cerimônias de Sincronizações do Agile Release Train (PO Synch);
  • Organizar e facilitar Sprint DEMO's para os demais integrantes do Agile Release Train;


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner (conhecimento será testado);
  • Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do Scrum e SAFe;
  • Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade;
  • Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil.

Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

  • Possuir certificação CSPO ou PSPO
  • Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)


Other:

  • English

title: AI Data Annotation Specialist
description:
Job Role : AI Data Annotation Specialist

Location: Brazil

Work Type: Freelance / Project-based


About the Role

We are looking for Freelance Data Annotation Specialists with strong English proficiency to support global AI and Large Language Model (LLM) projects. This is a project-based freelancing opportunity, ideal for individuals seeking flexible work while contributing to cutting-edge AI development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Annotate and review text-based data following detailed project guidelines
  • Perform language-centric tasks such as classification, evaluation, and reasoning
  • Maintain high accuracy, consistency, and quality standards
  • Meet defined productivity benchmarks within project timelines
  • Flag unclear or ambiguous data as per escalation guidelines
  • Ensure confidentiality and compliance with data security requirements


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Excellent English and Portuguese proficiency (written and spoken)
  • Strong attention to detail and analytical skills
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote/project-based setup
  • Basic computer literacy and familiarity with online tools
  • Prior experience in data annotation, content review, or similar roles is a plus


Selection Process

Candidates must successfully clear the following assessments:

  • LLM Assessment
  • Versant English Assessment

Only candidates who pass both assessments will be eligible for Background Verification (BGV)


Additional Information

  • This is a freelancing role and does not include full-time employment benefits
  • Background verification is mandatory prior to onboarding

title: Customer Service Rep (Remote)
description:
Elite Virtual Assistance (EVA) is expanding our support team for a rapidly growing network of Men’s Health Clinics across the United States. These clinics focus on helping men improve their health and confidence through services such as testosterone optimization, weight-loss programs (including medications like Ozempic), and overall wellness coaching.


We are seeking a high-caliber Customer Service Representative with exceptional English fluency, strong professionalism, and the ability to manage a diverse set of responsibilities. This is a remote role based in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities


1. Customer Service & Appointment Coordination
  • Answer inbound calls with empathy, clarity, and professionalism.
  • Set appointments for new potential customers (warm and high-intent leads).
  • Handle outbound follow-ups to support patient engagement and retention.
  • Provide accurate information on clinic services and guide callers through next steps.


2. Client Care & Wellness Follow-Up
  • Call patients who recently visited the clinic to check in, support them, and document their progress.
  • Help ensure clients stay on track with programs such as testosterone therapy or weight-loss plans.
  • Capture detailed notes and updates in the CRM to support continuity of care.


3. Administrative & Executive Assistant Support

Some clinic owners manage multiple businesses. At times, you will assist with:

  • General administrative tasks
  • Appointment booking and calendar management
  • Email organization and coordination
  • Light executive assistant duties outside the clinic scope


4. Content Support (As Requested by Individual Clinics)
  • Assist with simple social media content creation and posting
  • Support brand engagement and community-building initiatives


Required Qualifications
  • Exceptional English — written and spoken; near-native fluency required
  • Strong customer service orientation with a calm, confident phone presence
  • Ability to multitask while maintaining accuracy and detail
  • Professionalism, reliability, and strong time-management skills
  • Experience in healthcare, wellness, sales support, or customer service is a plus
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment supporting multiple stakeholders
  • Tech-savvy with the ability to learn new systems quickly (CRM, phone platforms, etc.)


Schedule & Work Environment
  • Standard schedule for this account is Wednesday–Sunday, 11:00 AM–7:00 PM (clinic’s local time) .
  • Some clinics operate Monday–Friday ; flexibility is a strong advantage.
  • Fully remote in Brazil , with stable internet required.


Compensation
  • $800–$1,000 USD/month (based on experience)
  • Performance incentives tied to quality, professionalism, and appointment outcomes
  • Opportunities for internal advancement within EVA as accounts grow


About EVA

Elite Virtual Assistance (EVA) provides high-quality remote staffing solutions for U.S.-based companies. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional service, strong operational structure, and top-tier talent from around the world. You will join a supportive, high-performance team with clear pathways for growth.

If you are driven, articulate, and excited to support a mission-driven wellness organization, we would love to meet you.

Apply now and help transform the customer experience for men striving to improve their health and confidence.

These clinics focus on helping men improve their health and confidence through services such as testosterone optimization, weight-loss programs (including medications like Ozempic), and overall wellness coaching.


We are seeking a high-caliber Customer Service Representative with exceptional English fluency, strong professionalism, and the ability to manage a diverse set of responsibilities. This is a remote role based in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities


1. Customer Service & Appointment Coordination
  • Answer inbound calls with empathy, clarity, and professionalism.
  • Set appointments for new potential customers (warm and high-intent leads).
  • Handle outbound follow-ups to support patient engagement and retention.
  • Provide accurate information on clinic services and guide callers through next steps.


2. Client Care & Wellness Follow-Up
  • Call patients who recently visited the clinic to check in, support them, and document their progress.
  • Help ensure clients stay on track with programs such as testosterone therapy or weight-loss plans.
  • Capture detailed notes and updates in the CRM to support continuity of care.


3. Administrative & Executive Assistant Support

Some clinic owners manage multiple businesses. At times, you will assist with:

  • General administrative tasks
  • Appointment booking and calendar management
  • Email organization and coordination
  • Light executive assistant duties outside the clinic scope


4. Content Support (As Requested by Individual Clinics)
  • Assist with simple social media content creation and posting
  • Support brand engagement and community-building initiatives


Required Qualifications
  • Exceptional English — written and spoken; near-native fluency required
  • Strong customer service orientation with a calm, confident phone presence
  • Ability to multitask while maintaining accuracy and detail
  • Professionalism, reliability, and strong time-management skills
  • Experience in healthcare, wellness, sales support, or customer service is a plus
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment supporting multiple stakeholders
  • Tech-savvy with the ability to learn new systems quickly (CRM, phone platforms, etc.)


Schedule & Work Environment
  • Standard schedule for this account is Wednesday–Sunday, 11:00 AM–7:00 PM (clinic’s local time) .
  • Some clinics operate Monday–Friday ; flexibility is a strong advantage.
  • Fully remote in Brazil , with stable internet required.


Compensation
  • $800–$1,000 USD/month (based on experience)
  • Performance incentives tied to quality, professionalism, and appointment outcomes
  • Opportunities for internal advancement within EVA as accounts grow


About EVA

Elite Virtual Assistance (EVA) provides high-quality remote staffing solutions for U.S.-based companies. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional service, strong operational structure, and top-tier talent from around the world. You will join a supportive, high-performance team with clear pathways for growth.

If you are driven, articulate, and excited to support a mission-driven wellness organization, we would love to meet you.

Apply now and help transform the customer experience for men striving to improve their health and confidence.

title: Specialist, Project Finance and M&A, LATAM
description:
About the Company:


Recurrent Energy is one of the world’s largest and most geographically diversified utility-scale solar and energy storage project development, ownership, and operations platforms. With an industry-leading team of in-house energy experts, we are a wholly-owned subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc. and function as Canadian Solar’s global development and power services business.


About the Position:


The Project Finance and M&A Specialist will play a critical role in supporting the company’s growth across LATAM by performing advanced financial analysis, developing robust financial models, and assisting in the structuring and execution of complex transactions. Working closely with the Project Finance and M&A team, this role provides analytical, strategic, and execution support throughout the transaction lifecycle — from origination and due diligence to closing and portfolio management.


Responsibilities:


  • Business Acumen and Financial Literacy - Demonstrates an understanding of relevant financial metrics and concepts.
  • Resource Planning - Plans for various possible timelines and contingencies for completing assigned work.
  • Collaborative - Displays positive demeanor in interactions with others both on the team and cross-functionally.
  • Project Structuring & Execution – Understands the legal, technical, and financial components of project finance structures; effectively contributes to transaction execution from term sheet to financial close.
  • Communication & Influence – Clearly articulates financial insights and recommendations; influences decision-making through well-reasoned analysis.
  • Results Orientation – Drives deliverables to completion with a focus on accuracy, timeliness, and value creation.
  • Adaptability & Learning Agility – Quickly assimilates new information, adjusts to changing deal dynamics, and continuously seeks to enhance technical and market knowledge.
  • Leadership & Mentoring – Provides guidance to junior members, reviews work outputs, and helps raise the overall quality of the team’s deliverables.


Qualifications and Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in project finance, M&A, or a similar role.
  • Proficiency in financial modeling tools (Excel, VBA).
  • Experience in cross-border transactions within LATAM markets.
  • Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently and take ownership of complex workstreams.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, capable of explaining technical results to financial stakeholders.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

Remuneração R$ 700,00 mais VT, horário de 8:00 às 13:00 ou de 13:00 às 18:00.

title: Analista de infraestrutura
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). title: Engagement Manager (Remote) - Brazil
description:
We are looking for a candidate with experience in Professional Services or customer-facing technical project management roles, preferably within the CRM space (Salesforce, Dynamics, or HubSpot). The ideal candidate is comfortable working directly with clients, gathering and analyzing requirements, and translating business needs into clear application and customer requirements.

The candidate should be able to produce design documentation based on business requirements and collaborate closely with developers to define technical requirements. Experience with programming or coding is strongly preferred, as it enables the candidate to create stronger technical design documents and effectively bridge the gap between business and engineering teams.


RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Understand the business requirements and processes of customers and translate them to specific functional specifications
  • Facilitating the negotiation of requirements amongst multiple stakeholders
  • Design, manage and conduct client interviews to validate the proposed solutions with requirements
  • Maintain requirements tracking to keep tight control over evolving business requirements and scope changes
  • Become a solution expert who can guide customers on how best to realize value from Magentrix products
  • Facilitating design sessions with the solution architect to define the solution, specifications, and scope.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously to meet delivery and budget targets
  • Coordinate with other Engagement Managers to conduct resource planning and ensure that the project members are utilized effectively.


QUALIFICATIONS


  • University degree in engineering, science or technology field or equivalent
  • Project Management certification or equivalent experience is an asset
  • Salesforce or other CRM certifications is an asset
  • Experience in preparing solution proposals and detailed functional requirements in consultation with clients and partners


LEAD EXPERIENCE


  • Knowledge of CRM application implementation ( Salesforce, Dynamics, or HubSpot)
  • Minimum 3-5 years working as a business analyst/system analyst in a technology setting
  • Able to work under stress and conflicting timelines when necessary
  • Strong interpersonal skills and communicates clearly and concisely (written and verbal)
  • Flexible, energetic, and able to work well with others in a client-focused, innovative and cross-functional environment
  • Proficiency in Google Apps, Project management tools, bug tracking & collaboration tools.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills balanced with common sense and initiative
  • Results-oriented and process-driven, with high expectations of self and team
  • Ability to set expectations with clients and promptly follow through to progress implementations effectively and in a timely manner
  • Ability to effectively receive and communicate feedback

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Engenheiro Full Stack
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Desenvolvimento de APIs REST com FastAPI
  • Consumo de dados do Snowflake
  • Testes, validações e integração com CI/CD
  • Criação de dashboards em React com gráficos e tabelas
  • Consumo de APIs e gerenciamento de estado


O que você precisa ter?

  • Inglês avançado
  • Forte experiência em React (React Query, Material UI)
  • Experiência com FastAPI ou similar
  • JavaScript/TypeScript sólido
  • Conhecimento básico de SQL


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Analista de BI (Governança de Dados)
description:
Atuar na concepção, evolução e sustentação de soluções analíticas corporativas, conectando BI, Big Data, APIs e Governança de Dados, garantindo qualidade, integração, escalabilidade e aderência às diretrizes da Vivo.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar na definição e implementação de soluções de BI corporativas;
  • Integrar dados provenientes de Big Data, Data Lake, Data Warehouse e APIs;
  • Apoiar o desenho e consumo de APIs de dados para uso analítico;
  • Garantir aderência às políticas de governança e qualidade de dados;
  • Atuar junto à Engenharia de Dados na definição de modelos e camadas de consumo;
  • Desenvolver e manter dashboards estratégicos em Power BI;
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na definição de indicadores e métricas;
  • Garantir consistência, rastreabilidade e confiabilidade dos dados;
  • Documentar soluções, fluxos e regras de negócio.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência com soluções de BI em ambientes corporativos;
  • Conhecimento em Big Data (Data Lake, Hadoop, Databricks, etc.);
  • Experiência no consumo e entendimento de APIs de dados;
  • Conhecimento em Governança de Dados e qualidade da informação;
  • SQL avançado;
  • Power BI;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação entre áreas técnicas e negócio.


Você vai amar trabalhar aqui se:

title: PMO - Brazil
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated IT Project Manager with 3–4 years of experience to oversee and coordinate our IT projects and initiatives. This role involves managing projects from initiation to delivery, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring that all project milestones are achieved on time and within scope.


Key Responsibilities

Lead and manage IT projects using Agile/Scrum methodologies

Plan, execute, and monitor projects to meet deadlines and deliverables

Utilize Jira for project tracking, task management, and reporting

Coordinate with developers, QA teams, and stakeholders to ensure smooth execution

Identify project risks and implement mitigation strategies

Conduct regular status meetings and provide progress reports to management

Requisitos

Experience: 3-4 years in IT project management or similar role

Methodologies: Strong knowledge of Scrum processes and Agile frameworks

Tools: Proficient in Jira and other project management tools

Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English (both written and spoken)

Strong organizational and communication skills

Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment


Preferred Qualifications

Experience in software development or IT infrastructure projects

Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or PMP certification is a plus

title: Software Engineer (US/UK International Projects)
description:
Software Engineer - Data Platform (International Client)

Location: Florianópolis, Brazil | Hybrid

Language: English (daily use with US/UK clients)


About the Opportunity

Join our consultancy team and work directly with a leading insurance company in the US/UK, building their complete data platform from the ground up. This is your chance to bring world-class, AI augmented software engineering practices to a greenfield data engineering project while collaborating daily with international teams.


What You'll Do

  • Design and build a robust data platform for a major insurance company
  • Bring solid software engineering principles to data engineering challenges
  • Work embedded within the client's team, driving technical excellence
  • Orchestrate AI agents to research, plan and implement complex data pipelines while demonstrating to the wider team how to leverage these tools to increase velocity and quality.
  • Collaborate in English with distributed teams across the US and UK


What We're Looking For

Must Have:

  • Excellent communication skills in English - you'll be working daily with international clients
  • Strong software engineering mindset - clean code, testing, reliability, and maintainability are in your DNA
  • Deep understanding of relational databases and large-scale data systems
  • Comfort with AI-augmented development - you're already using AI agents and modern dev tools

You'll Thrive Here If:

  • You want international exposure while staying in Brazil
  • You value engineering excellence over quick fixes
  • You're excited about hybrid work (office + remote flexibility in Floripa)
  • You see data engineering as a software engineering discipline


About Us

We're a Florianópolis-based software development and consultancy company working with clients in the US and UK. We believe in combining the best of Brazilian tech talent with international opportunities.

  • Ready to level up your career with international experience? Let's talk.

title: Application Developer - PL
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter aplicativos web e sistemas de software de acordo com as necessidades do negócio;
  • Analisar requisitos, projetar soluções, escrever código, realizar testes e fazer a implantação de novos recursos e funcionalidades;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para resolver problemas, melhorar a qualidade do código e a eficiência dos processos;
  • Participar de reuniões e workshops para entender as demandas dos clientes e stakeholders.
  • Documentar o desenvolvimento e as atualizações realizadas nos sistemas;
  • Suportar e resolver incidentes relacionados aos aplicativos em produção.


Requisitos:


  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos como desenvolvedor de aplicativos web;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em linguagens de programação como Java, JavaScript, entre outras;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks e bibliotecas como Spring, Angular, etc;
  • Habilidades em desenvolvimento back-end e front-end;
  • Experiência em bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, como Scrum;
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade de trabalho em equipe e habilidades de resolução de problemas.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência em arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Conhecimento em DevOps e ferramentas de CI/CD.



Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Data Architect
description:
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.


Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 23 sequential quarters of growth with $422.5M in Q3 FY26 revenue, up 4.0% Q-o-Q and 17.3% Y-o-Y growth. Our 26,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We won the 2025 ISG Star of Excellence™ Award for AI and Data Excellence and were named a Leader in the Everest Group Talent Readiness for Next-generation Data, Analytics and AI Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2025 .


Our company fosters a values-driven and people-centric work environment that enables our employees to:


  • Accelerate growth, both professionally and personally
  • Impact the world in powerful, positive ways, using the latest technologies
  • Enjoy collaborative innovation, with diversity and work-life wellbeing at the core
  • Unlock global opportunities to work and learn with the industry’s best


Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers


About Position:


Role: Data Architect

Location: Remote Mexico

Job Type: Full Time Employment


What You'll Do:

  • 10+ years in data architecture, data pieplines, SQL, and Python
  • Strong experience with SQL and optomizing queries and tables for performance
  • Understanding of data pipeline operation and data validation
  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment
  • Hands on experience with Data Lakes such as Snowflake and Redshift
  • Experience building business logic and data validation for SQL and Data Lake deployments
  • Strong experience with AWS and cloud deployments
  • Highly effective communicator and technical write able to convey implementation details to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong teamwork and ability to handle multipe on going initiatives and follow up on them


Expertise You'll Bring:

  • Stakeholder facilitation and alignment
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science
  • Continuous process improvement mindset
  • Software Development experience
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environment


Benefits:


  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Culture focused on talent development with quarterly promotion cycles and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
  • Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
  • Annual health check-ups
  • Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents


Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:


Persistent Ltd. is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.


We offer hybrid work options and flexible working hours to accommodate various needs and preferences.

Our office is equipped with accessible facilities, including adjustable workstations, ergonomic chairs, and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.

If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive.

title: Senior Go Developer
description:
Senior Go Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a Senior Software Engineer Backend you will be part of a fast-paced, collaborative team developing our attack surface intelligence capabilities. You will be a critical contributor to the development and integration of reconnaissance technologies and products while also moving forward the state of engineering best practices in our cybersecurity platform. If you enjoy pivoting between different problems and meeting new challenges every day while developing solutions that are mission critical to the organization, this role is for you!

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop and integrate cybersecurity testing and analysis systems with best-in-class cybersecurity platform;
  • Build high-performance, resilient, scalable cloud-based software, microservices architecture and containers;
  • Take software through CI/CD all the way to production and own its quality and availability;
  • Utilize GCP platform to build and run highly-available software systems;
  • Identify and resolve performance issues across systems and components;
  • Collaborate on a cross-functional team, working with Product, Operations, and Platform Engineering;
  • Integrate monitoring and alerting capabilities with backend modules to allow proactive improvements to availability and response times;
  • Design, implement and deliver well-tested, scalable, highly available systems;
  • Own and ideate technical solutions for product requirements and user stories;
  • Actively engage and participate in design and code reviews;
  • Offer guidance and support to junior team members, encouraging and cultivating a culture of continuous learning within the team

Essential Skills


  • Experience in distributed-systems and backend software engineering;
  • Strong Golang Required;
  • Strong experience and understanding of microservices, REST API design, gRPC, unit testing, BDD testing;
  • Strong design skills required – UML is a bonus; exposure to Domain Driven Design desirable;
  • Experience with asynchronous messaging technologies such as Google PubSub, Kafka;
  • In depth knowledge of NoSQL and RDBMS technologies;
  • Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud Environments (GCP preferred);
  • Experience working on agile teams;
  • Experience developing scalable and observable microservice-based applications
  • Experience with GitOps and DevOps principles, practices and tools;
  • A proven ability to thrive in a collaborative environment involving different stakeholders and subject matter experts.


Highly Desirable Skills


  • Interest in security / penetration testing;
  • Interest in GenAI and LLM technologies.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior Application Developer
description:
Senior Application Developer – AI Course Bots

100% Remote | Long-Term Contract | EST Working Hours

About the Role

Our client is seeking an experienced Senior Application Developer to help build next-generation AI-powered course bots using generative AI technologies on AWS Cloud .

This role will play a key part in transforming business education through intelligent, interactive, and scalable learning experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop enterprise-grade AI course bots with a focus on scalability, performance, extensibility, and system integration.
  • Implement the technical vision of the course bot platform using appropriate AI models, APIs, and AWS cloud services .
  • Collaborate closely with faculty, product managers, and ed-tech experts to translate educational requirements into technical solutions.
  • Build secure, robust, and scalable cloud-native solutions on AWS for bot deployment and operations.
  • Follow best practices in AI-focused software development , including coding standards, code reviews, and testing methodologies.
  • Integrate cutting-edge generative AI technologies to keep the platform at the forefront of educational innovation.
  • Implement data ingestion, storage, and retrieval pipelines to support AI model workflows.
  • Ensure seamless integration with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and other digital platforms.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and analytics to track bot performance, usage patterns, and learning outcomes.
  • Enforce security, privacy, and compliance standards , including FERPA and educational data protection requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical delivery with business goals and user experience.
  • Stay updated on emerging trends in AI, cloud computing, and educational technology and recommend innovative enhancements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering , or related field.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, primarily with cloud-native applications .
  • Strong experience with serverless architectures, microservices, and event-driven systems .
  • Hands-on experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) , including GraphRAG and contextual retrieval .
  • Experience with generative AI evaluation frameworks .
  • Experience with multi-agent frameworks such as AutoGen, LangGraph , or similar tools.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services , especially:
  • AI/ML: SageMaker, Bedrock
  • Serverless: Lambda, Step Functions
  • Data: S3, DynamoDB, RDS
  • Strong production-level coding skills in Python and JavaScript / TypeScript .
  • Experience building AI/NLP applications using pre-trained and autoregressive LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, Google, etc.).
  • Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and GraphQL services .
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices , including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and automated testing.
  • Solid understanding of data security, privacy, and compliance in educational environments.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments .

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in educational technology or e-learning platforms .
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Advanced understanding of LLMs and machine learning algorithms .
  • Contributions to open-source projects or academic research .
  • Knowledge of modern front-end frameworks such as React or Vue.js and backend integration.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
Appointment Setter - Fully Remote

About the Job:

We are looking for someone who will be setting appointments with leads, has great written and spoken English skills, has attention to detail and organizational skills.

You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us set appointments for our clients' leads. You will be responsible for replying via the text message system with our warm leads on time, booking them into appointments, making phone calls, and asking a few qualifying questions. Full training is provided.

This is a full-time role Mon-Fri for 40 hours per week with occasional overtime. Work time from 8:30am – 5.00pm New York Time (with a 30-minute break). You will be working with US clients, but you can live outside of the US; therefore, we would like to have someone in our team who knows American Culture and speaks decent English. Experience with appointment setting, understanding a fitness niche and/or having a sales/ business/ marketing background is an advantage. The company may offer growth opportunities depending on performance.

Requirements:

  • Strong English skills, a neutral accent, and familiarity with American culture.
  • Commitment to working 8:30am – 5.00pm New York Time.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Passion for digital marketing and a hunger to learn.
  • Experience in marketing or fitness is a bonus, but not required.
  • Attention to detail is a must ( !!!>> When filling out the form, put your postcode as G9999, DO NOT put your real postcode <
  • Comfortable working in a small team and picking up other jobs as required

What We Offer:

  • Enjoy long-term stability and 100% remote.
  • Join a supportive team.
  • Get top-notch training in marketing and beyond.

title: Pricing Operations Manager/Production Manager
description:
Please send me resume in English format only


Remote role

Target start date: March

Time zone: CST


Role Overview:

The team is looking for someone with an operations background who can support the Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams.

This role will focus heavily on metrics, reporting, and sales process improvement. The team is currently working on building reports in Power BI and needs someone who is highly data-oriented and understands business context—not just a report builder.


The ideal candidate should be able to:

Help build and refine metrics and reporting

Analyze data and provide meaningful insights

Identify areas of concern and highlight issues

Redefine and improve existing reports and analysis

Extract data, work with Excel, and be hands-on with data

Not necessarily a Power BI expert or data engineer, but comfortable working with data directly


Ideal Candidate Profile:

Minimum 5 years of experience

Strong understanding of workflows, processes, and flowcharts

Ability to work closely with business teams

Salesforce.com experience is highly preferred

Experience measuring sales team performance and understanding where data resides

Ability to assess process metrics and behavioral metrics (e.g., ensuring accurate data entry across sales organizations)

Capable of telling a clear story through data and explaining discrepancies in current reporting

Bachelor’s degree is a plus

Experience in companies like VMware would be beneficial

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Perfil Profissional:

Buscamos um desenvolvedor versátil e inovador com experiência em Kotlin, AWS e Go, especializado em criar soluções de software eficientes e escaláveis. Este profissional deve combinar habilidades de desenvolvimento back-end e serviços em nuvem para construir aplicativos de alto desempenho, que atendem às necessidades de negócios dinâmicos.


Habilidades e Competências:

  • Desenvolvimento em Kotlin e Go: Proficiência em ambas as linguagens, com experiência prática na construção de aplicativos e serviços back-end, utilizando Kotlin para desenvolvimento de aplicações e Go para serviços de alta performance.
  • AWS: Ampla experiência em utilizar serviços AWS, como ECS, Lambda, API Gateway e S3, para desenvolver e otimizar aplicações em nuvem.
  • Microserviços: Experiência em projetar arquiteturas de microserviços que possibilitem escalabilidade e manutenção eficiente, integrando soluções em Kotlin e Go.
  • Banco de Dados: Familiaridade com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, incluindo otimização de consultas e implementação de estratégias de persistência de dados.
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Habilidade em trabalhar em ambientes ágeis, utilizando práticas de CI/CD para garantir alta qualidade e entrega contínua de software.

title: Android Developer (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in Android development;
  • Hands-on experience with Coroutines or RxJava;
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-structured code;
  • Experience working in collaborative development environments;
  • English level B2 or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively;
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese;
  • Willingness to relocate from Brazil to Portugal;
  • Available to work in Porto or Lisbon (hybrid work model).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in Android development;
  • Hands-on experience with Coroutines or RxJava;
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-structured code;
  • Experience working in collaborative development environments;
  • English level B2 or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively;
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese;
  • Willingness to relocate from Brazil to Portugal;
  • Available to work in Porto or Lisbon (hybrid work model).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

title: Application Developer (Maintenance - JAVA/MySQL)
description:
We are looking for an Application Developer with strong experience in Java and My to support and enhance our client's application system, on the transportation product line.

The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

  • Portal & Server Management: Troubleshoot portal server ers, monitor AWS logs, and ensure report delivery.
  • ETL & Data Operations: Manage ETL file uploads, monitor ongoing/completed loads, and resolve missing data issues.
  • Reporting (JasperReports): Maintain and enhance custom reports, add/remove columns and filters, manage run tickets, and troubleshoot disappearing reports.
  • Database Management (My): Perform schema updates, optimize queries, and ensure data integrity for reporting and ETL processes.
  • Integrations: Support Samsara, Geotab, and Motive integrations and data imports.
  • Environment Management: Handle migrations between Alpha, Beta, and Production environments.
  • Bulk Updates: Execute mass-scale changes (Tank ID, Lease Name, Account, Terminal details) and perform data cleanup.


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience using Java and My
  • Solid understanding of AWS logs and backend troubleshooting, preferably using Cloud watch
  • Comfortable working in CI/CD environments with Agile development practices
  • Understanding of ETL & Data Management for file uploads and load monitoring
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a proactive mindset
  • Able to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with JasperReports
  • Prior experience using React.js


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Assistente Juridico Administrativo
description:
Estamos em busca de um Assistente Juridico Administrativo para fazer parte do time da Fevereiro & Cruz Marcas e Patentes, um escritório de 13 anos de idade na cidade de São Paulo e agora está iniciando a sua jornada na cidade de Campinas. Nosso maior propósito é gerar e agregar valor para as empresas através dos seus ativos marcas e patentes, com experiência de serviço, a fim de ficarmos marcados em suas memórias pela qualidade do nosso trabalho.

Principais responsabilidades da função:

• Abertura e cadastro de casos novos;

• Solicitação de cadastramento de clientes/documentos;

• Acompanhamento dos prazos administrativos;

• Gestão de ferramentas jurídicas;

• Preenchimento de formulários;

• Geração de guias e petições eletrônicas;

• Elaboração de peças administrativas e seu protocolamento;

• Análise de contratos;

• Apoio à elaboração de documentos legais. Auxilia na redação e organização de petições, contratos, relatórios, pareceres e outros documentos jurídicos.

• Realiza pesquisas em legislações, jurisprudências, doutrinas e outros documentos legais para fornecer informações atualizadas e embasar argumentos e defesas.

• Envio de e-mails periódicos;

• Elaboração de relatórios/pareceres para clientes;

• Atendimento a clientes.

Execução de outras atividades correlatas à função, que possam surgir no decorrer das operações, demonstrando flexibilidade e adaptabilidade para lidar com diversas demandas.


Requisitos:

• Bacharel em Direito ou cursando a partir do 4º semestre;

• Experiência com sistemas de gestão jurídica

• Capacidade de lidar com situações de estresse e pressão, especialmente ao lidar diretamente com os clientes.

• Demonstração de responsabilidade extrema no cumprimento das tarefas atribuídas.

• Proficiência excepcional na língua portuguesa, tanto na comunicação verbal quanto na escrita.

• Proatividade para antecipar necessidades e resolver problemas de forma eficiente.

• Habilidade organizacional para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e garantir a eficiência operacional.


Será considerado um diferencial ter experiência prévia no ramo da propriedade industrial.


Modelo de trabalho: presencial Disponibilidade de tempo: Horário: Segunda à sexta-feira, das 08:30h às 18:00h Contratação: CLT. Remuneração: R$2.500,00. Benefícios: Vale alimentação/refeição + vale transporte.
